feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Evidence: moving the sensor row from y=0.04 to y=0.06 (iteration 2 to 3) lowered oval max_error from 0.0617 to 0.0598 and raised oval progress from 0.53 to 0.87, so forward sensing helps the oval. Widening the outer pair to x=±0.05 (iteration 4) cut oval progress to 0.80 and left s-bend and slalom max_error at about 0.062, so outer spacing is not the bend-entry lever. Softening the controller (kp 2.0, kd 0.35) moved oval oscillation only from 0.339 to 0.333, so damping alone does not fix oscillation. The 12 mm footprint (iteration 5) scored 139.76, below the 16 mm best, so keep 16 mm unless new evidence says otherwise. Narrowing the track is the candidate's test of turn authority. If the next race shows s-bend and slalom max_error below 0.06 with oval progress at or above 0.85, keep the track near 0.085 m and treat remaining bend-exit work as controller-side. If the oval progress drops below 0.85, the narrower track is over-steering and the track should go back to 0.09 m. If the line_loss_events rise above 1.0 on any track, the 16 mm footprints are missing the tape edge on tight bends and the outer pair should be checked.
requested_changes: If s-bend or slalom max_error is still at or above 0.06 while oval progress holds at or above 0.85: try wheel_track 0.08 m (the minimum allowed) with the rest unchanged. Evidence: narrowing wheel_track from 0.10 to 0.09 in iterations 1 to 2 raised oval progress from 0.46 to 0.53, so turn authority has improved progress before.

If oval progress falls below 0.85 with wheel_track 0.085 m: return wheel_track to 0.09 m and keep sensor_size 0.016 at y = 0.06 with x = ±0.04. Evidence: iteration 3 (this geometry at 0.09 m) gave oval progress 0.87 and max_error 0.0598, the best oval result so far.

If sensor row is forward at y = 0.06 and s-bend or slalom max_error stays at or above 0.06 at wheel_track 0.085 m: try y = 0.07 with x = ±0.04 and sensor_size 0.016. Evidence: moving the row from y=0.04 to y=0.06 in iterations 2 to 3 lowered oval max_error from 0.0617 to 0.0598 and raised oval progress from 0.53 to 0.87.
